lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Kitten ( ΦωΦ )

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: I was just wondering something.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: How many hours do you usually sleep?
Around five hours...
Around ten hours?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Goodness...

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Don't you get tired sleeping so little?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: It's terrible for your skin too.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Sleep is even more important than exercise, you know.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: No matter how busy you are, you should still get at least eight hours.
I'll try.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Woooow!

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: We really are alike

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: in so many ways.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Getting plenty of sleep is important, you know?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: So I always make sure to get at least eight hours.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: The reason I'm asking is because

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Prika and I actually had a little argument about this.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Personally, I can handle being busy no matter how packed my day gets,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: but I have to get enough sleep.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Prika, on the other hand,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: says that since our schedules are unpredictable,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: we need to know when to sacrifice sleep if we have to.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: The problem is if I don't get enough sleep,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: I get stressed out, my skin breaks out,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: and it basically ruins my entire schedule the next day.
That's a tough one.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: It really is.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: We're on the same team,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: so we have to find some kind of middle ground.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: But we just haven't been able to see eye to eye yet.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: So I was curious

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: how much sleep you usually get, Kitten.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Though in the end, it's still up to us to decide.
Hope it all works out.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: I'll see what I can do!

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Make sure you get a good night's sleep tonight

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: and dream about me, hehe! <(*ΦωΦ*)/
